description: MyInvestor helps users explore MyInvestor's public investment catalogue from ChatGPT. Users can search and inspect mutual funds, ETFs, and stocks; resolve fund names; compare investments; discover automated portfolios; and simulate a custom portfolio using historical market data. The app is read-only and does not access customer accounts, place orders, subscribe to products, or execute financial transactions.
